title: Correct terminal debugger job status
changes: Clear the completed job from pending_control in its terminal response and retain the original request/job correlation across response-publication retries.
validation: Wine/Xvfb bounded synthetic search verified live status, refusal of a different ID, console completion of the actual request ID and targeted cancellation; a separate 500ms request timed out at the client and then stopped at the server. Both original terminal replies exposed stale pending status, motivating this fix.

Corrected isolated Windows GNU test and production builds pass; all 18 Wine protocol tests pass, including cancellation, deadline and publication retry with original job correlation. Frozen 1512 sources and 22 overlays match.

A new bounded Wine/Xvfb search was cancelled by its observed request ID: terminal outcome was cancelled, pending_control was null and full terminal state matched a later status. The synthetic session and display closed with protected pins exact.
limitations: DBG2-13/15 remain open: duplicate-request retry semantics, live replay-profile selection and complete menu/CLI/console equivalence require further work.
Native Windows/Linux and physical input were not tested; a client timeout without acknowledgement is not proof that the server has stopped.
